blockers: Confirm whether derived conversion data may be redistributed in a commercial app.
Acquire or verify additional market-specific clothing charts before claiming global coverage; ISO 8559 defines designation methodology but is not a universal S/M/L conversion table.
Expand dresses, outerwear, specialist garments and product-family overrides after the conversion core is implemented; unsupported combinations must remain explicitly unavailable.
Obtain a Sensor Tower/AppTweak/data.ai export before using monthly-download or retention claims.
